name: tiva-master-dashboard
description: Tiva Master Dashboard — Founder's Command Center with ERPNext Integration
author: Tiva (foundertiva-crypto)

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.setup: npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../dashboard && npm install
scripts.docker:restart: docker compose down && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.clean: rm -rf api/dist api/node_modules dashboard/.next dashboard/node_modules node_modules
